themeDescription: Using AI ethically, taking responsibility for outcomes

days.title: What is Ethics? - Thinking About Right and Wrong
days.learning_objective: Understand ethics as the systematic study of right and wrong, and why ethical thinking matters.

days.title: AI Ethics - Special Considerations for AI
days.learning_objective: Explore the unique ethical questions raised by AI: bias, transparency, accountability, impact.

days.title: Responsibility - Owning Your Choices and Outcomes
days.learning_objective: Develop a sense of personal responsibility for decisions and their consequences.

days.title: AI and Responsibility - Who's Responsible for AI Outputs?
days.learning_objective: Grapple with questions of responsibility when AI is involved in decisions and actions.

days.title: Honesty and AI - Truthfulness in an AI World
days.learning_objective: Commit to honesty about AI use and AI-generated content in your work and communications.

days.title: Fairness and AI - Bias in AI Systems
days.learning_objective: Understand how AI systems can encode and amplify biases, and advocate for fairness.

days.title: Privacy and AI - Data and Personal Information
days.learning_objective: Recognize privacy implications of AI systems and make informed choices about data sharing.

days.title: Transparency - Being Open About AI Use
days.learning_objective: Practice transparency about when and how AI is used, building trust through disclosure.

days.title: Academic Integrity - Learning vs Shortcuts
days.learning_objective: Distinguish between using AI to enhance learning versus using it to bypass learning.

days.title: AI and Cheating - Where's the Line?
days.learning_objective: Navigate the complex question of what constitutes appropriate versus inappropriate AI use in education.

days.title: AI and Work - Ethical Professional Use
days.learning_objective: Apply ethical principles to professional use of AI, including disclosure and quality assurance.

days.title: AI and Art - Attribution and Ownership
days.learning_objective: Explore questions of authorship, attribution, and ownership when AI is involved in creative work.

days.title: AI and Truth - Deepfakes and Misinformation
days.learning_objective: Understand the threat of AI-generated misinformation and deepfakes to truth and trust.

days.title: AI and Jobs - Automation and Human Work
days.learning_objective: Consider the ethical implications of AI automation on employment and human dignity in work.

days.title: AI and Power - Who Controls AI?
days.learning_objective: Examine questions of power and control in AI development and deployment.

days.title: AI and Access - Who Gets to Use AI?
days.learning_objective: Consider equity and access issues—who benefits from AI and who is left behind.

days.title: Environmental Impact - AI's Carbon Footprint
days.learning_objective: Understand the environmental costs of AI training and use, and consider sustainability.

days.title: Unintended Consequences - Thinking Ahead
days.learning_objective: Develop the habit of considering potential unintended consequences of AI applications.

days.title: Ethical Frameworks - Tools for Moral Reasoning
days.learning_objective: Learn ethical frameworks (utilitarian, deontological, virtue) as tools for analyzing dilemmas.

days.title: Stakeholder Thinking - Who Is Affected?
days.learning_objective: Practice identifying all stakeholders affected by decisions, including those often overlooked.

days.title: Long-Term Thinking - Future Generations
days.learning_objective: Consider the impact of current AI decisions on future generations and long-term outcomes.

days.title: Personal Values - What Do You Believe?
days.learning_objective: Clarify your personal values as a foundation for ethical decision-making with AI.

days.title: Conflicting Values - When Good Things Clash
days.learning_objective: Navigate situations where legitimate values conflict and trade-offs must be made.

days.title: Moral Courage - Doing Right When It's Hard
days.learning_objective: Build the courage to act ethically even when it's difficult or unpopular.

days.title: Moral Mistakes - Learning from Ethical Errors
days.learning_objective: Learn to acknowledge, learn from, and make amends for ethical mistakes.

days.title: Ethical Leadership - Influencing Others Positively
days.learning_objective: Lead by example in ethical AI use, positively influencing peers and communities.

days.title: Systems and Ethics - When Structures Create Problems
days.learning_objective: Recognize when ethical problems are systemic and work for structural change.

days.title: Individual Action - Your Choices Matter
days.learning_objective: Believe that individual ethical choices matter and contribute to larger patterns.

days.title: Collective Action - Changing Together
days.learning_objective: Engage in collective action for ethical AI development and use.

days.title: AI for Good - Positive Applications
days.learning_objective: Celebrate and support AI applications that genuinely benefit humanity and the planet.

days.title: Month in Review - Ethics in the AI Age
days.learning_objective: Synthesize ethical principles into a personal code for responsible AI engagement.
